Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb `stb_vorbis.c` at commit 1ee679c (version 1.22), with one fix marked `nxnative:` in `decode_residue` (and the matching temp-memory estimate): residue type 2 interleaves all channels of a submap, so its vector holds n × channels values; upstream assumed n × 2, which cut the 5.1 movie tracks of Link's Awakening short and desynchronised the bitstream (verified sample-exact against libvorbis afterwards). License in LICENSE (MIT or public domain, your choice; the same text ends the source file).
Use: the host decodes the Vorbis sound tracks of the games' WebM movies with it (`dm/host/hle_movie.c` includes the file with `STB_VORBIS_NO_STDIO`, `STB_VORBIS_NO_PULLDATA_API` and `STB_VORBIS_NO_INTEGER_CONVERSION`, and feeds each raw packet in as an Ogg page of its own). First needed by Link's Awakening.
